newsitem.title: USA: RF Monolithics adds to gains after EPS.
newsitem.headline: RF Monolithics adds to gains after EPS.

text.p: Shares in radio frequency components maker RF Monolithics Inc on Friday added to their gains on the back of a strong earnings report earlier in the week.

Late Wednesday the Dallas-based company reported fiscal third quarter earnings of $0.20 a share, up from $0.11 a year earlier. Robertson, Stephens and Co analyst Dan Niles called the results "awesome," topping his forecast of $0.15 a share.
He said he raised his fiscal 1997 earnings forecast on the company to $0.65 from $0.55 and boosted fiscal 1998 to $0.90 from $0.70.
"It's a great small cap stock that's finally broken out," he said.
The stock was up 3-1/4 to 22-1/4 after a rise 2-7/8 on Thursday.
